title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 13
subtitle: Save the Bees!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 13: Save the Bees! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: We are back with Anna and Caroline and the bees. Last time, Anna was afraid. (Anna: I'm not afraid of bees!) But Caroline is helping her to stay safe. Look at sentences that start with “If” to find more conditional sentences. Remember, Type 1 conditionals use the present tense and “will,” and Type 2 use the past tense and “would.” Now, let's find out what happens with Anna and the bees.
dialogue.zh: 我们又和安娜、卡洛琳还有蜜蜂在一起了。上次安娜很害怕。（安娜：我不怕蜜蜂！）但卡洛琳在帮她保持安全。找以 If 开头的句子，就能找到更多条件句。记住，第一种条件句用现在时和 will，第二种用过去时和 would。现在看看安娜和蜜蜂会怎样。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: I have a feeling that your fear of bees will be gone soon. There are things beekeepers do to protect ourselves. For example, we wear protective clothing. This is a beekeeper’s veil, suit and gloves. There are other things we can do, too. If I use a smoker, the bees will stay calm.
dialogue.zh: 我有预感，你对蜜蜂的害怕很快就会消失。养蜂人会做一些事来保护自己。比如我们穿防护服。这是养蜂面罩、套装和手套。还有别的办法。如果我用喷烟器，蜜蜂就会保持冷静。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s use smoke … lots of smoke.
dialogue.zh: 我们用烟吧……很多很多烟。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Okay, Anna, that’s enough smoke. Another thing you can do is stay calm. Okay. When I lift the frame, you will see the bees.
dialogue.zh: 好了，安娜，烟够了。另一件事是保持冷静。好。我提起蜂框时，你就会看到蜜蜂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m ready. Let's do this thing!
dialogue.zh: 我准备好了。开始吧！

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Okay, let's put on our protective clothing.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们穿上防护服。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: I will carefully take out a frame. This is where the bees live. There are worker bees, drone bees and the queen bee. The bees have different jobs. The queen bee lays the eggs. The worker bees collect nectar and pollen from flowers and bring it back to the hive. Then they make honey! Now, you hold the frame. There are the bees.
dialogue.zh: 我会小心地拿出一个蜂框。这就是蜜蜂住的地方。有工蜂、雄蜂和蜂后。蜜蜂有不同的工作。蜂后产卵。工蜂从花上采集花蜜和花粉，带回蜂箱。然后它们酿蜜！现在你拿着这个框。蜜蜂在这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are so many! And they are so busy! Now I know why we say, “busy as a bee!”
dialogue.zh: 好多啊！它们好忙！现在我知道为什么说“忙得像蜜蜂”了！

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Good job, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 做得好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Caroline, bees are beautiful and important. If I wanted to help the bees, what would I do?
dialogue.zh: 卡洛琳，蜜蜂又美丽又重要。如果我想帮助蜜蜂，我该做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Great question. You can plant native flowers that bees like. Here’s a book to help you know which ones to plant.
dialogue.zh: 好问题。你可以种蜜蜂喜欢的本地花。这本书能帮你知道该种哪些。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s a beautiful book. And look, it tells you which bees like which types of flowers.
dialogue.zh: 这本书很漂亮。看，它还告诉你哪种蜜蜂喜欢哪种花。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: It also tells you how the flowers affect the flavor of the honey.
dialogue.zh: 它还告诉你这些花怎样影响蜂蜜的味道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Flowers make a big difference to bees. If they don’t eat, they won’t live.
dialogue.zh: 花对蜜蜂很重要。如果它们不吃东西，就活不下去。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Buying local honey also helps the bees. If you want to help bees, do those two things.
dialogue.zh: 买本地蜂蜜也有帮助。如果你想帮助蜜蜂，就做这两件事。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I learned a lot about bees. Hey, if I worked with bees, I would not need protective clothing! Guess what? That was a Type 2 conditional. And I heard a Type 1 conditional, too. (Anna: If they don’t eat, they won’t live.)
dialogue.zh: 我学到了很多关于蜜蜂的知识。嘿，如果我和蜜蜂一起工作，就不需要防护服！猜怎么着？那是第二种条件句。我还听到了第一种条件句。（安娜：If they don’t eat, they won’t live.）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for the book, Caroline, and the bee puppet and for teaching me about bees. Look … I’m not scared.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你的书，卡洛琳，还有蜜蜂玩偶，也谢谢你教我认识蜜蜂。看……我不害怕了。

dialogue.speaker: Caroline
dialogue.en: Good job, Anna. If you ever want to see the bees again, I’ll be here! You have my business card. I'll let you see yourself out.
dialogue.zh: 做得好，安娜。如果你以后还想看蜜蜂，我会在这儿！你有我的名片。你自己出去就行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! Bye! I will plant tons of flowers!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！再见！我会种好多花！

dialogue.speaker: Bees
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna. (bees spell out the words)
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜。（蜜蜂拼出这些字）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, bees! Oh, and I'm sorry about hitting that hive when I was a little girl.
dialogue.zh: 应该的，蜜蜂们！哦，还有，对不起我小时候打过那个蜂巢。

dialogue.speaker: Bees
dialogue.en: We love you, Anna. (bees make a heart sign.)
dialogue.zh: 我们爱你，安娜。（蜜蜂摆出爱心）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Take care, bees! (to herself) Which way is the Metro?
dialogue.zh: 保重，蜜蜂们！（自言自语）地铁往哪边走？

dialogue.speaker: Bees
dialogue.en: That way. (they draw an arrow)
dialogue.zh: 那边。（它们画出一个箭头）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: So, if you want to learn more about bees, visit your local beekeeper like Anna did. Maybe you can try some local honey, too. Now it’s your turn. Practice making conditional sentences. If you practice, you will become better at them. That's type 1!
dialogue.zh: 所以，如果你想多了解蜜蜂，就像安娜一样去拜访本地养蜂人。也许你还可以尝尝本地蜂蜜。现在轮到你了。练习造条件句。如果你练习，你就会更擅长。这就是第一种条件句！

quiz.prompt: What does Caroline use to keep the bees calm?
What two things does Caroline say help the bees?
choices: Plant native flowers and buy local honey

quiz.prompt: What does Anna say she will do at the end?
